FLOOD & WEATHER VULNERABILITY ASSESSMENT
FLOOD HISTORY:
No flood losses recorded at this location since construction (2015-2026).
Nairobi CBD area: Low to moderate flood risk
Proximity to Nairobi River: 1.2 km (south-southeast)
River elevation: ~1,265m ASL (building at 1,612m)
Flood potential: Minimal (terrain elevation provides natural protection)
OTHER WEATHER EVENTS:

UNDERWRITING SUMMARY & RECOMMENDATIONS

FACULTATIVE FLOOD COVER (if requested):
Nairobi CBD location presents minimal flood risk. If flood cover is sought, standard
rates apply with 5% deductible or KES 5,000,000 minimum. Flood limit can be set at
full TIV (KES 1,090,000,000) with confidence.
